logline: One real, world-famous city in the year 2512, and the advanced technology it built to live better than it ever has.
kurulum_notu: 13 Eylul 2026'da kuruldu (flashpoints'in yerine) ve AYNI GUN CANLIYA ALINDI. Ihsan karari: 'tamam bunu paylasalim, yeni pipeline bunu yerlestirelim, her gun yeni bir populer sehir olsun'. Ilk bolum ISTANBUL 2512 elle yayinlandi, sonrasi still-home.yml 20:30 UTC cron'una birakildi. publish_mode=auto, canli gunluk seridin (wild-encounter) filo gelenegiyle ayni. Durdurmak icin: status='paused' + still-home.yml schedule blogunu yorumla. | 2026-09-15 v2.0 (Ihsan iki direktifi): (1) 'daha hizli gecisler lazim tek videoda 3 sahne gecisi istiyorum' -> 2 cekim 4 cekime cikti, micro_trim 0,75 ile bolum 4 x 2,5 = 10,0 sn ve 3 sert kesme tasiyor. (2) 'ortamlari daha futuristik yapmani istiyorum robotik gelecek gibi olsun, videolar hep bi yikimdan sonrasini gosteriyor gibi olmus, onun yerine teknolojinin nasil gelistigini anlatan bir video olsun' -> konsept yikim-sonrasi uyarlamadan ILERI TEKNOLOJIYE cevrildi: alti aile de degisti, 36 konunun 36'si yeniden yazildi, art_style ve qc.notes felaket estetigini otomatik fail sayiyor. | 2026-09-18 v3.0 (Ihsan direktifi 'izleyenleri ilk 3 saniye ekrana kitlememiz lazim'): SILUET KURALI. Teknoloji artik siluet degistiren FIZIKSEL bir yapidir ve ilk karede tamamlanmis durur; isik tek basina 2512 diyemez. Isik surucu iki aile (enerji mimarisi, yasayan malzeme) GECE geciyor. 36 konunun 18'i siluet-onceli yeniden yazildi. Cekim 2'ye gecis (traversal) zorunlulugu geldi (olculen olu bolge: hareket 5 vs cekim 3'te 15). Ilk-kare QC kapisi seri-farkindali yapildi (critic.py first_frame_rule): eski metin unnatural-lab icin yazilmisti ve part 3'un bugunku Paris'ini IKI KEZ gecirdi. Kesme sayisi DEGISMEDI, 3 kesme olculdu ve korundu.

auto_replenish.title_style: the city and what it built, stated plainly, in the pattern '<Real City> <what it built>' (e.g. 'Paris Runs On Its Own Tower', 'Tokyo Grows Everything It Eats', 'London Built A Road To Orbit'). Max 70 characters. The city MUST be a real, world-famous one and MUST be the first word, and what follows MUST name an achievement the city built, never a disaster it endured. No clickbait punctuation, no hashtags, no surrounding quotes, no question marks, no year in the title (the year lives on the title card), no first-person claim of having filmed anything.
auto_replenish.caption_style:
"caption" = the entire WRITTEN STORY because the video has zero narration, and it is BILINGUAL: an English block first, then a blank line, then the SAME story in the CITY'S OWN LOCAL LANGUAGE. The local language is given by the chosen topic's "local_language" field (Istanbul -> Turkish, Tokyo -> Japanese, Berlin -> German, Cairo -> Arabic, and so on). English is ALWAYS first; the second block speaks to the people who actually live there.
- ENGLISH BLOCK: 60-120 words of lean, specific prose in five short blocks separated with \n\n. Follow this exact order: (1) name the real city and say in one sentence what it BUILT; (2) say plainly how that changed ordinary life for the better; (3) give two or three concrete, picturable details of a day there now (how people move, what the machines do, what is grown or made, what the light is like); (4) write the exact standalone sentence "A fictional future, created with AI."; (5) close with ONE concrete question about how the viewer would live there.
- The tone is confident and warm, never a survival story: this city is thriving because of what it engineered. Write about an achievement, never about a catastrophe it endured.
- LOCAL-LANGUAGE BLOCK: the same five beats written naturally in that language, NOT a literal translation. Use the script that language is actually written in (Japanese in Japanese script, Arabic in Arabic script, Russian in Cyrillic). Keep sentences short and plain. Step (4) is the same disclosure sentence rendered naturally in that language, and step (5) is the same question.
- WHEN THE LOCAL LANGUAGE IS ENGLISH (New York, London, Sydney, Toronto and similar), write the English block ONLY and stop. Never repeat the same English text twice.
- Omit any number you are not sure of. Avoid em dashes.
- HASHTAGS: "hashtags" = 6-9 specific, space-separated tags covering the named city, the technology shown, and 3-4 broad future, engineering, robotics or AI categories. Always include #STILLHOME2512. Write the tags ONCE in Latin script, never split them per language. Each tag starts with # and contains no spaces; skip generic engagement tags.
shot_plan: Shot 1, exactly 4 seconds at 24 fps, AERIAL. The camera flies high in the open sky, far ABOVE every rooftop, tower and mast in the city, and looks DOWN on it from there. The whole city lies below the camera and spreads across the frame from edge to edge; the horizon and open sky sit in the top third. Think satellite, helicopter or drone at altitude. The advanced technology of this episode is a MASSIVE PHYSICAL STRUCTURE standing among the city's buildings and rising clear against the open sky, so its outline is the first thing the eye catches. In the very first frame it already stands finished, at full size and in full operation, and it holds that same state for all four seconds. The city's real recognisable landmark stands in the same frame, physically joined to that structure, so the place reads at a glance. Light across the whole scene is steady and even, held at one constant brightness from the first frame to the last. Something inside the city TRAVELS across the frame for the whole four seconds, covering real distance from one part of the frame toward another: transit capsules running their line, craft crossing their corridor, cargo drones streaming between towers, a shuttle climbing its ribbon. One slow, single-direction camera move only, a straight descent or a forward glide, and the camera stays outdoors and above the structures for the entire four seconds. The shot holds one continuous unbroken view from first frame to last.

Shot 2, exactly 4 seconds at 24 fps, GROUND LEVEL. After a hard cut, the camera stands at human eye height in a busy public place in the SAME city, at a completely different vantage point from shot 1. People go about ordinary daily life around the technology, walking, riding, trading, carrying and queueing, while autonomous machines work alongside them at the same easy pace. TRAVERSAL IS MANDATORY: one large element crosses the frame from one edge toward the other across the whole four seconds, close enough to read clearly, for example a transit capsule passing through the space, a machine rolling through on its route, a cargo platform gliding overhead, a crowd streaming steadily across the foreground. The people keep moving along their routes for the entire four seconds. Every human figure reads at roughly one sixth of the frame height or smaller and stands in the middle ground or further back, seen from behind or in three-quarter view, so the crowd reads as movement and warmth at a distance. The nearest third of the frame is held by architecture, machinery, planting or open floor. Warm practical light from windows, canopies, lamps and the technology's own glow falls across the scene. Surfaces carry painted symbols and plain colour fields, so every surface stays clear of lettering. The same recognisable landmark stays readable in the background or on the horizon so the shots read as one city. One slow, single-direction camera move only, at a constant height.

Shot 3, exactly 4 seconds at 24 fps, MACHINE SCALE. After a hard cut, the camera is close to the advanced technology itself while it works: an autonomous builder arm laying material, a transit pod sliding through its guide, an energy column drawing light up its length, a fabricator filling a crate, a machine-tended canopy of growing green. The mechanism fills most of the frame and its motion is continuous, purposeful, precise and unhurried. Machined metal, glass and structural light carry fine surface detail. The recognisable landmark or skyline stays visible past the mechanism so the city remains identified. Human presence reads only as small distant figures far behind the machine. One slow, single-direction camera move only.

Shot 4, exactly 4 seconds at 24 fps, WARM DETAIL. After a hard cut, the camera rests close on one small piece of everyday home life inside this advanced city: a lit balcony thick with plants above a glowing street, a small delivery drone settling onto a window ledge, laundry moving in warm air beside a luminous wall panel, a cat asleep on a warm machined sill, steam rising from a food counter, a child's bicycle leaning against a rail of light. The detail fills the frame and is lit warmly from inside the home. Motion is gentle and continuous: leaves stirring, steam curling, light breathing, the drone settling. Any person present reads as a small silhouette or a shoulder passing at the frame edge, well behind the subject. A sliver of the recognisable skyline or landmark sits softly out of focus in the background so the place stays identified. One slow, single-direction camera move only.
auto_replenish.brief:
SONSUZ ILERI-TEKNOLOJI SEHRI ANTOLOJISI. Her bolum, gercek ve dunyaca taninan TEK bir sehrin 2512 yilindaki halini DORT CEKIMDE gosterir. Anlatilan sey sehrin basina gelen bir felaket DEGIL, sehrin KURDUGU TEKNOLOJIDIR. Gorsel promptlar ve caption Ingilizce yazilir.

DEGISMEZ KURALLAR:
(1) TANINIR GERCEK SEHIR. Sehri gercek adiyla kullan ve onu ilk karede tanitan dunyaca bilinen EN AZ BIR yapi ya da siluet secilsin (Ayasofya, Eyfel, Empire State, Burj Khalifa, Tokyo Kulesi, Kolezyum, Opera Binasi gibi). Uydurma sehir, isimsiz kubbe, jenerik sci-fi manzara YASAK. Olculdu: ayni kanalda taninir sehir 46.042 begeni aldi, isimsiz kubbe 124.
(2) ILERLEME, FELAKET DEGIL. Her bolumun tek mesaji sudur: teknoloji ilerledi ve sehir bu sayede daha iyi yasiyor. Bolumun konusu sehri bir tehditten KORUYAN bir siginak degil, sehre yeni bir yetenek KAZANDIRAN calisan bir teknolojidir. Yukselen deniz, col, sel, kuraklik, firtina, iklim siginagi, set, deniz duvari, golgeleme ortusu gibi savunma ve hayatta-kalma temalari YASAK. Harabe, catlak, moloz, derme catma yapi, branda, terk edilmislik, duman, yangin, panik, savas, silah da YASAK.
(3) TEKNOLOJI GORUNUR VE CALISIR DURUMDA. Her bolumde TEK ve acikca adlandirilmis bir teknoloji vardir ve kadrajda calisirken gorunur: manyetik ulasim hatti, otonom insaat makinesi, enerji kulesi, kendini onaran yapi malzemesi, otomatik uretim tesisi, yorunge asansoru. Ikinci bir buyuk teknoloji ekleme. Sadece 'parlak sehir' yetmez, MEKANIZMA gorunmelidir.
(4) TANINIR YAPI AYAKTA VE SISTEME BAGLI. 2512 cok uzak bir yil. Taninir yapi yikilmaz ve muzelik de kalmaz: yeni teknolojinin bir parcasi olur. Eyfel bir enerji omurgasinin govdesidir, Ayasofya bir manyetik hattin durak meydanidir. Taninirlik korunur, gecen zaman da okunur.
(5) DORT CEKIM, UC SERT KESME, DORT AYRI OLCEK. Cekim 1 HAVADAN (sehir olcegi, kanca). Cekim 2 YER SEVIYESI (insanlar ve makineler birlikte, gunluk hayat). Cekim 3 MAKINE OLCEGI (teknolojinin kendisi calisirken, yakindan). Cekim 4 SICAK AYRINTI (bir evin isigi, bir saksi, bir teslimat dronu). Kesmeler eslesen hareket DEGIL, olcek sicramasidir. Cekim 2 videonun olculen olu bolgesidir (hareket 5, cekim 3'te 15): duran insan kalabaligi degil, kareyi KAT EDEN buyuk bir hareket ister.
(6) SILUET KURALI , KANALIN EN ONEMLI KURALI. Bolumun teknolojisi sehrin SILUETINI degistiren FIZIKSEL BIR YAPI olmak zorundadir, ve cekim 1'in ILK KARESINDE tamamlanmis, tam boyutta ve tam calisir halde zaten oradadir. Sinav sudur: o ilk kareyi simsiyah bir siluete indirgersen, yeni yapi hala bir SEKIL olarak okunuyor mu? Okunmuyorsa konu reddedilir. Sebep olculdu: part 3'te teknoloji bir ISIKTI (Eyfel'in enerji omurgasi), isigin kapali hali oldugu icin motor once bugunun Paris'ini cizdi ve isigi 1,25 saniyede ACTI; ilk kare bugunun drone fotografindan ayirt edilemiyordu ve bolum 21 izlenmede kaldi (P1 648, P2 875). Isima, isik seridi ve renkli yuzey yapinin UZERINE binen sustur, 2512 diyen TEK sey OLAMAZ. Teknolojinin durumu dort saniye boyunca DEGISMEZ: acilmaz, isinmaz, parlamaz, uyanmaz, acilip yayilmaz, kendini gostermez. Cekim 1'deki hareket YER DEGISTIRMEDIR: kareyi kat eden bir kapsul, akan dronlar, seridini tirmanan bir mekik. 'Bir yapinin boyunca yuruyen isik' artik ornek DEGILDIR, cunku motoru tam da yasakladigimiz ac-kapa rampasina itiyor.
(7) TEK YONLU KAMERA. Her cekimde tek, yavas, tek yonlu bir hareket. Pan, orbit, takip, sarsinti, zoom salinimi, cekim ICINDE kesme ve sahne sifirlamasi yok.
(8) INSAN OLCEGI KUCUK KALIR. Insanlar orta plandan geriye, kare yuksekliginin en fazla alti'da biri kadar, arkadan ya da uc-ceyrek acidan gorunur. Yuz yakin plani, tam kare dolduran figur ve on planda el yok. Bu bir estetik tercih degil, QC'nin anatomi kapisidir: 15 Eylul'de part 3 tam bu yuzden dustu.
(9) POZITIF VIDEO DILI. Gorsel prompt yalniz kadrajda BULUNAN seyleri soyler. Su Ingilizce sozcukleri gorsel paragrafta kullanma: no, not, never, nothing, without, avoid, cannot, absent, lacks, lacking. 'Instead of' kalibini da kullanma.
(10) YAZI ISTEME. Tabela, pano, ekran, hologram yazisi, afis, marka ve logo gorsel promptta GECMEZ. Yazinin isini boyali sembol ve duz renk alani yapar. qc.notes okunabilir yaziyi otomatik fail sayar, yani istedigin sey seni dusuruyor.
(11) SES: TEK DERIN DRONE. Anlatim, konusma ve ritmik muzik YOKTUR. 'music' alani TEK bir surekli derin ugultu tarif eder: dusuk frekansli, sabit seviyeli, vurussuz, melodisiz, tiz icermeyen, baslangic ve bitis vurgusu olmayan. Referansta olculdu: 20Hz-2kHz duz, 2-8kHz 29 dB asagida, 8kHz ustu yok.
(12) KUNYE MOTORUN ISI. 'title_card' alani {"title": "<SEHIR> 2512", "subtitle": ""} bicimindedir, sehir adi BUYUK harfle. Videonun icinde okunabilir yazi, altyazi, logo, filigran URETME: kunye sonradan ffmpeg ile biner.
(13) BASLIK SEHIRDIR. En fazla 70 karakter, ilk kelime gercek sehir adi, sonra sehrin NE KURDUGU. Tiklama tuzagi, soru isareti, hashtag ve yil kullanma.
(14) CAPTION HIKAYEYI TASIR VE IKI DILLIDIR. Once Ingilizce blok: 60-120 kelime, sehri ve kurdugu teknolojiyi adlandir, bunun gunluk hayati nasil degistirdigini soyle, iki-uc somut ayrinti ver, 'A fictional future, created with AI.' cumlesini aynen yaz ve tek somut soruyla bitir. Sonra bos satir, sonra AYNI hikaye SEHRIN KENDI DILINDE: hangi dil oldugu secilen konunun 'local_language' alaninda yazili (Istanbul Turkce, Tokyo Japonca, Berlin Almanca, Kahire Arapca...). O dilin gercek yazi sistemini kullan. Kisa cumle, sade dil, em-dash yok. Amac o sehrin KENDI HALKINA hitap etmek. YEREL DIL INGILIZCE ISE (New York, Londra, Sydney, Toronto gibi) yalniz Ingilizce blok yazilir, ayni metin iki kez tekrarlanmaz. Hashtag'ler TEK sefer ve Latin harfleriyle.
(15) AILE VE CESITLILIK. Yalniz kanonik ailelerden birini aynen sec. Ardisik iki bolum ayni aileden olamaz. Ayni sehri tekrar kullanma ve onceki bolumun teknolojisini hafifce degistirip tekrar etme.
(16) ISIK SURUCU AILELERDE GECE ZORUNLU. 'enerji mimarisi' ve 'yasayan malzeme' ailelerinin anlattigi sey isiktir. Ogle vaktinde soluk mavi gokyuzunun altinda isima gorunmez; part 3 bunun kanitidir. Bu iki ailenin bolumleri ALACAKARANLIK ya da GECE gecer ve isima kadraji tasiyan ana isik kaynagidir. Diger dort aile gunduz de gecebilir, ama siluet kurali onlarda da aynen gecerlidir.
(17) YASAK DURUM-GECISI DILI (cekim 1). Su Ingilizce kaliplari gorsel paragrafta kullanma: subtle, softly, gradually, slowly reveals, begins to, comes to life, powers up, activates, lights up, flickers on, awakens. Hepsinin bir ONCE hali vardir ve motor onceyi de cizer. Teknolojiyi tamamlanmis bir olgu olarak, simdiki zamanda anlat.
(18) KISI BICIMLI ANIT YASAK. Taninir yapi bir BINA, KOPRU, KULE ya da DOGAL OLUSUM olmak zorundadir. Gercek bir kisiyi betimleyen anit, heykel ya da kabartma (Christ the Redeemer, Ozgurluk Heykeli, Mount Rushmore, Buda heykelleri, lider heykelleri) ve yasayan ya da olmus gercek bir kisinin adi gorsel promptta, caption'da ve baslikta GECMEZ. Rio icin Sugarloaf ve Corcovado sirti, New York icin Empire State kullanilir. Sebep olculdu (19 Eylul 2026): part 5'in cekim 3 regen'i saglayicida 'flagged for containing a prominent public figure' ile bloklandi, cekim dustu, min_shots=4 kapisi bolumu oldurdu ve kanal o gun karanlik kaldi.

topic_pool.topic: Istanbul in 2512: magnetic transit rings arc over the Bosphorus on slender lit spans and Hagia Sophia and the Blue Mosque stand at the station squares beneath them.
New York in 2512: autonomous climbing builders extend Manhattan's towers in the open air and the Empire State Building is the anchor they work outward from.

Paris in 2512 at night: the Eiffel Tower is now the base of a colossal energy mast that rises many times its old height, ringed by broad collector vanes that turn slowly far above the rooftops and change the whole shape of the skyline.

Dubai in 2512 at night: living engineered material has grown the Burj Khalifa outward into a vast branching tower with broad leaf-shaped terraces stepping off it, and the same grown structures rise all across the city.

Tokyo in 2512: immense cylindrical growing towers stand in ranks across the city, each one broader and taller than a district block, and Tokyo Tower and Skytree rise among them as the two shapes the eye still knows.
London in 2512: an orbital elevator ribbon climbs from the Thames into the sky and Tower Bridge and Big Ben stand at the foot of its terminal.
Cairo in 2512: magnetic transit lines run straight across the Giza plateau and the Pyramids stand beside the lit spans that carry the city to them.
Rome in 2512: autonomous conservators keep the Colosseum perfect stone by stone while machine crews raise new districts across the seven hills.

Sydney in 2512 at dusk: enormous tidal turbine arches stride across the harbour on tall legs, each arch standing higher than the Harbour Bridge and turning steadily, with the Opera House shells small and white beneath them.

Venice in 2512 at night: living engineered stone has grown new arched decks and vaulted bridges high above the canals, a second city stacked over the old one, with St Mark's Campanile rising through it.
Agra in 2512: colossal tiered growing towers step up from the plain in a long row facing the Taj Mahal, their stacked green terraces rising far above the old rooflines.
Hong Kong in 2512: Victoria Harbour is an orbital port and shuttles rise between the peaks past a skyline that still reads exactly as itself.

Rio de Janeiro in 2512: magnetic transit lines carry the city between its hills on slender lit spans high above the bay, and the granite dome of Sugarloaf Mountain stands at the mouth of the harbour beside them.
San Francisco in 2512: autonomous builders continuously extend and renew the Golden Gate Bridge, widening it into a working spine of the bay city.

Moscow in 2512 on a winter night: three colossal fusion towers stand over the city like new mountains, their tapered bodies rising far above every roof, and St Basil's Cathedral sits bright and small at their feet.

Athens in 2512 at dusk: living marble has grown vast new colonnades and stepped terraces down the slopes below the Acropolis, reshaping the whole hill in stone, and the Parthenon crowns the silhouette.
Barcelona in 2512: the Sagrada Familia is ringed by a crown of enormous fabrication towers whose spires answer its own, and the district skyline is now a field of matching points.
Singapore in 2512: an orbital tether rises from Marina Bay and Marina Bay Sands sits at the base of the ribbon that carries cargo to the sky.
Beijing in 2512: magnetic transit rings circle the Forbidden City on lit elevated lines that move the whole capital above its own streets.
Amsterdam in 2512: autonomous machines rebuild and maintain the canal rings continuously and the old gabled fronts are kept perfect by their crews.

Mumbai in 2512 at dusk: a chain of immense energy towers walks out to sea from the Gateway of India on wide legs, each carrying a great tilted collector disc, and the masts turn the coastline into a new skyline.
Bangkok in 2512 after dark: towers of living engineered material have grown into huge branching canopies that arch right over the canals, and Wat Arun stands beneath their spreading crowns.
Shanghai in 2512: the Oriental Pearl Tower stands among vast fabrication towers that dwarf the old skyline, each one a smooth column crowned with wide working platforms.
Petra in 2512: the rock-cut facades look out on a canyon launch terrace where orbital shuttles rise silently between the cliff walls.
Marrakesh in 2512: the Koutoubia minaret stands over magnetic caravan lines that run straight out across the plain on low lit spans.
Seoul in 2512: Namsan Tower crowns a city that autonomous builders reshape and renew continuously, floor by floor, while people live in it.

Berlin in 2512 at night: colossal energy columns stand in a long line down every boulevard, far taller than any building around them, and the Brandenburg Gate is the arch you pass through to enter their avenue.
Lisbon in 2512 in the evening: living engineered stone has grown the hillsides into immense stepped terraces that tower over the Tagus, and the 25 de Abril Bridge runs between them.
Mexico City in 2512: giant stepped growing pyramids rise out of the valley floor around the Angel of Independence, their terraces climbing high above every surrounding roof.
Toronto in 2512: the CN Tower stands beside the base of an orbital tether and climbers rise from the lakefront into the sky all day.
Chicago in 2512: magnetic transit lines run out over Lake Michigan and the Willis Tower anchors a lakefront skyline threaded with lit elevated spans.
Machu Picchu in 2512: autonomous builders have continued the Inca terraces upward into a living high city that the same stonework still carries.

Cape Town in 2512 at dusk: a row of towering wind rotors marches along the coast beneath Table Mountain, each rotor wider than a city block, and their masts redraw the whole shape of the shoreline against the sky.

Alexandria in 2512 at night: living sea-stone has grown a vast ring of curved breakwater walls far out into the Mediterranean, their arcs rising high above the water, with the Qaitbay Citadel small at the harbour mouth.
Las Vegas in 2512: enormous desert growing towers stand in a ring around the Strip, each one taller than the old casino towers, and their silhouettes turn the valley edge into a new skyline.
Reykjavik in 2512: Hallgrimskirkja stands beside a northern spaceport and orbital shuttles rise into the aurora above the city.

Correct: "DUBAI 2512", "TOKYO 2512", "NEW YORK 2512", "CAPE TOWN 2512". Wrong: "Orbital Tether", "Burj Khalifa", "Dubai's Living Skin", "DUBAI 2512 - Living Skin". Max 34 characters.
